semantics.prediction: Combinational direction from PHT[predict_pc XOR current global history]; return current history. At positive edge with predict_valid shift in the pre-edge prediction.
semantics.training: At positive edge with train_valid update only PHT[train_pc XOR train_history] toward actual outcome.
semantics.recovery: train_valid AND train_mispredicted overrides speculative history update; history becomes {train_history[5:0], train_taken}.
semantics.concurrency: Same-entry prediction sees pre-edge counter, with no training bypass.
semantics.reset: Original explicitly specifies asynchronous active-high reset. Assume history zero and all counters weakly not-taken (01); reset values are omitted in supplied original.
semantics.initialization: No power-on initialization before reset is specified; sequential state remains unknown before reset.
semantics.invalid_prediction: Outputs remain combinational even when predict_valid is zero; no history update.

numeric.history: 7-bit shift register: discard oldest bit 6, append newest direction at bit 0.
numeric.table: 128 two-bit unsigned saturating counters: 0 strongly not taken, 1 weakly not taken, 2 weakly taken, 3 strongly taken.
numeric.direction: Counter MSB; taken increments up to 3, not-taken decrements down to 0.
numeric.index: 7-bit XOR, no PC slicing beyond supplied 7 bits.

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral model of original XOR addressing, integer bounded counter updates, and history shift; compare before and after positive edges.
verification.directed: Async reset off-edge, all 128 entries, both saturation limits and threshold transitions, same-entry concurrent training/prediction, recovery priority, valid gating, history truncation.
verification.random: Deterministic randomized transactions, including concurrent requests and repeated resets.
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS emitted only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Reset state is not specified: choose zero global history and weakly not-taken counters (01). Development checks validate this stated assumption, not an explicit original reset value.
History shift orientation is implicit: interpret newest branch as bit 0.
Outputs when predict_valid=0 are unspecified: expose current combinational prediction and history.
Referenced timing diagram is absent from supplied text; follow explicit pre-edge read and next-positive-edge write description.
